subject: Interim lead assignment for Platform Eng - transfer approval needed
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interim lead assignment for Platform Eng - transfer approval needed

Hi Laura and Markus —

Quick note to start the thread for Eduardo Santos' manager transition. Eduardo (Platform Eng IC, started 2023-07) has accepted the internal transfer from Product to Platform and will formally join the Platform team on 2026-03-29. His current manager, Rafael Mendes, will be out on sabbatical starting 2026-03-22 through 2026-06-15.

We need 1) an interim manager assigned for Eduardo effective 2026-03-22 for performance, 1:1s, and calibration during Rafael's absence, and 2) HR approval on the transfer paperwork (attached). My recommendation is to have Markus step in as interim lead for Eduardo and Ellis (two-person span) through the sabbatical window, then reassess in June. Markus — can you confirm capacity and any conflict with your existing commitments?

Laura — please confirm the HR checklist is complete and share any redlines you see on the attached transfer consent doc. My goal is to close approvals by 2026-03-12 so we can schedule a warm handoff meeting week of 03/15.

Attachments: org_change_form_20260305.pdf, transfer_consent_mr_santos.docx

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Director, People Ops
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim lead assignment for Platform Eng - transfer approval needed

Monica —

Happy to help. I reviewed Eduardo's last six months of project work and the staffing plan for my pod; I have bandwidth to take him on as interim. A couple notes: 1) I'll need a brief ramp week (03/15–03/19) to sync on open PRs and roadmap priorities, 2) Ellis is currently assigned to a cross-product spike that ends 03/20 — after that I'll consolidate weekly 1:1s.

I do not foresee any managerial conflicts, but I want to be explicit about performance calibration: Eduardo had a couple constructive feedback items in last cycle around documentation and delivery estimates. I'll schedule a calibration with Rishi once the transfer is approved so we're aligned on goals/objectives for the interim period.

Assume tentatively confirmed from my side. If HR needs signatures or a manager acceptance form, loop me in.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jenny O'Connor <jenny.oconnor@talentlaw.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim lead assignment for Platform Eng - transfer approval needed

Thanks — all.

HR has reviewed the attached transfer_consent_mr_santos.docx and the org_change_form. Two minor redlines: the effective date in section 2 (transfer start) needs to be 2026-03-29 per Eduardo's request, and we need Rafael's signature on the sabbatical acknowledgement (we have an email from Rafael confirming dates; I can archive that with the file but legal prefers a signature). I copied Jenny from TalentLaw for the sabbatical clause wording — Jenny, can you confirm the standard acknowledgement wording is sufficient or if we should add a clause about interim decision-making authority?

Vivek — legal asked that we confirm any client-facing obligations: Eduardo has a short-term contractor engagement with Acme (internal liaison John Smith) that runs through 2026-04-10. Please confirm there are no contract objections to the transfer or to Markus as interim manager (cust-facing point-of-contact).

Once those items are confirmed I can finalize the HR packet and push it to DocuSign. Targeting signatures and DocuSign completion by 2026-03-12.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. People Partner, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Interim lead assignment for Platform Eng - transfer approval needed

On Thu, 10 Mar 2026 at 09:27, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> HR has reviewed the attached transfer_consent_mr_santos.docx and the org_change_form. Two minor redlines: the effective date in section 2 (transfer start) needs to be 2026-03-29 per Eduardo's request...

All good from my side. I spoke with John Smith at Acme earlier today — they acknowledge the short contractor overlap and are fine with Markus as the interim point of contact. Rafael provided the signed sabbatical acknowledgement and I uploaded it to the HR folder (link above).

Markus — thank you for taking this on. Please make sure you schedule Eduardo's 1:1 for the first week of the interim (03/22) and the calibration with me before 03/29. Monica and Laura — if you can push the DocuSign packet now I will approve the transfer on Hub (deal id: HR-PLTF-2026-087) once signatures are complete.

Attachments: (see earlier)
